cases.finding: At an audited observed frame the native teacher box covers a different visible person from the annotated target; larger-lr coarse output follows the incorrect region more strongly. Correctness at a later frame does not make every anchor correct.

Teacher localizes the annotated target at the observed frame, while the old adaptive output moves toward the adjacent person at a nearby unobserved frame. The original large-lr coarse winner does not resolve this transfer error.

At the inspected unobserved frame, old adaptive output covers a distant different person; E and the smaller-lr/softer-tau/earlier global winner stay near the annotated target. Observed-frame improvement therefore coexists with cross-frame identity displacement.

The inspected observed teacher box selects the known adult mentioned in the relation query, whereas the annotated requested object is the child. Old adaptation follows the adult more strongly; smaller updates reduce but do not eliminate the error.

At the inspected observed frames the teacher extent covers most of the person while the annotated requested region is lower/smaller. At the selected unobserved frame the old adaptation moves into background; the smaller-lr/softer-tau global coarse winner avoids most of that displacement but retains extent mismatch.

An inspected observed teacher box matches the requested person, while E and the adaptive output at the inspected unobserved frame cover the neighboring person. The smaller-lr coarse winner does not repair this case. The initialization-only curve and final adapted outcome are retained separately; this case is not hidden by the global gain.

scope: Selected explanatory frames plus full saved parent metrics, not an exhaustive identity-error annotation of all frames or all parents.
